channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.168.0
item.description: Codex CLI 0.168.0's release notes gather changelog links covering four version ranges from 0.166.0 through 0.168.0, including the 0.167.2 patch, each pointing to its full GitHub release. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
item.description: IBM Granite released LLMON, an LLM-native markup language that uses reserved special tokens to explicitly label context structure and offers lossless JSON conversion, alongside experimental 3B and 8B previews built on Granite 4.1. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Build once, run on any agent: A practical guide to agent skills
item.description: A GitHub Universe 2026 conversation explains agent skills as versioned directories built around SKILL.md that package repeatable instructions for review and reuse, while tools, credentials, and permissions remain host-specific. (GitHub AI & ML)

item.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
item.description: Amplitude says its product agent Wave, roughly 80% powered by OpenAI models including GPT‑6.1 Sol and GPT‑6 Luna, cuts product-improvement cycles from about a month to 1–2 days and lifted homepage card-driven sends 160%. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen targets fast, cost-efficient agentic workflows with a 1 million-token context priced at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, scoring 51 under default high thinking versus Argon's 50. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: Google Search is rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen globally, which VP of Product Robby Stein calls its largest model upgrade yet, letting users ask multi-part questions and get answers with images, tables and links. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Actions for ARM32 Linux & Windows retirement
item.description: GitHub Actions hosted runners will stop ARM32 job execution on Windows and Linux by 8 December 2026, removing native AArch32 user-space support after Node 24 dropped ARM32 following node20's end of support. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
item.description: Gondola more than doubled revenue year over year while using Codex to boost monthly engineering output 25% and lead-engineer output 50%, and non-engineers such as Jojo Hesketh now prototype Programs workflows, according to OpenAI's customer story. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Secret scanning detects Cloudflare service tokens
item.description: Secret scanning now automatically detects Cloudflare service tokens as the cloudflare_access_service_token type, reports partner secrets found in public repositories to the issuer, and alerts on user secrets in both public and private repositories. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Alibaba enters the AI music race with end-to-end full-song generation, adding another member to its "Happy" series
item.description: Alibaba's HappyShrimp AI music app has launched on iOS and Android with end-to-end full-song generation, offering a standard membership at roughly 30 yuan per month for 150 songs. (AIbase)

item.title: Holiday Extras is rethinking what it can build with Codex
item.description: Holiday Extras rebuilt its main app with Codex in two weeks instead of over six months, lifting open-to-book conversion 32.5%, cutting errors from 19% to 9% and moving from annual to weekly releases. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Public monitoring alerts now have direct links
item.description: GitHub Enterprise Cloud’s Public monitoring view now lets users click any alert number to open that individual alert and use its URL to bookmark the finding or share it with teammates who have access. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Anthropic Eyes Biggest IPO Ever With $90.4B Raise as Demand Tops Sixfold
item.description: Anthropic's IPO has drawn orders for about six times the available shares, as the Claude maker seeks up to $64.4 billion plus $26 billion privately—$90.4 billion that would surpass SpaceX as the largest listing ever. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic IPO oversubscribed six times as Nvidia drops $10 billion to grab a seat
item.description: Anthropic’s IPO subscription orders have reached about six times available shares, with the company seeking up to $64.4 billion plus a $26 billion private placement at a roughly $1.4 trillion valuation as Nvidia plans to subscribe about $10 billion. (AIbase)

item.title: Edge0 open-sources a 145B on-device model that cuts memory use by 60% while still coding at full performance.
item.description: Edge0 has open-sourced Edge0-145B and Edge0-120B, with the 145B MoE model running locally on personal computers using only about 10B active parameters per inference, cutting memory 60% while retaining code-writing capability. (AIbase)

item.title: OpenAI raises another $15 billion on the eve of its IPO, pushing its valuation to $1.25 trillion
item.description: CNBC's Nov. 13 report that OpenAI closed a $15 billion private round at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation also details Q3 revenue of about $10 billion against $10.9 billion in operating losses as the company builds capital ahead of a 2027 IPO. (AIbase)

item.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit
item.description: Hugging Face's CEO has vowed to continue fighting for open source AI following Jensen Huang's exit, a stance that raises questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: OpenAI's robotics unit pivots to "in-model integration," folding embodied AI into its general foundation model framework
item.description: OpenAI disbanded its independent robotics team on November 13, folding members into regular model training while judging robotics a vertical task of general models, and the piece traces 2026 humanoid-robot hiring and repeated route reversals. (AIbase)

item.title: Grok Bot 1.0 — Bots work together alongside your team
item.description: Grok Bot 1.0's page promises bots that work alongside your team, but the body returns 403 Forbidden and demands JavaScript and cookies, leaving the actual product details unverified. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Five years after shutting down, Xiami returns from the dead with AI: Alibaba launches Happy Xiami for 30 yuan
item.description: Alibaba's ATH (TokenHub) has launched HappyShrimp on iOS and Android at version 0.2.14, letting users generate full songs from natural language for about 30 yuan a month — 150 tracks, roughly 0.2 yuan each. (AIbase)
